headline: A 50-acre Sobha township on North Bengaluru's second road to the airport.
pitch: Hennur–Bagalur Road is where three things meet: the airport, the Manyata office district and a metro line now in trial runs. Sobha Parq City puts a full township, with its own clubhouse, sports club and shops, at that meeting point.

reasons.title: The address is getting a metro
reasons.text: The airport metro (Blue Line) began trial runs in November 2026. It links KR Puram, Nagawara, Hebbal and Yelahanka to the airport, with a Pink Line interchange at Nagawara.

reasons.title: Prices here have a track record
reasons.text: Hennur Road apartments rose about 12.8% in one year and about 82.8% in five years, to roughly ₹10,600 per sq.ft. An earlier ANAROCK study measured 48% growth from 2018 to late 2024.
reasons.source: 99acres locality data via PropNewz, May 2026; ANAROCK Hennur Road micro-market report, Q3 2024

reasons.title: Two ways to the airport
reasons.text: The site is about 15 to 16 km from Kempegowda International Airport and can reach it by Hennur–Bagalur Road or by Bellary Road. Few North Bengaluru addresses have a second route.

reasons.title: Jobs are moving north
reasons.text: Manyata Tech Park sits down Hennur Main Road. To the north, the KIADB Aerospace Park covers nearly 950 acres of aerospace manufacturing and testing.

reasons.title: A township, not a tower
reasons.text: More than 50 acres and 3,100 homes, a clubhouse of about 1.16 lakh sq.ft., a separate sports club and a one-kilometre tree avenue. Shops, a salon and restaurants are planned at the entrance, so daily life stays inside the gate.
reasons.source: Project presentation, as listed by 100 Yards

reasons.title: You are early
reasons.text: The project is at pre-launch. Buyers who enter at this stage choose from the full range of towers, floors and sizes, before the launch price list is published.
reasons.source: Project status, as listed by 100 Yards

upcoming.status: Trial runs began November 2026. 38.44 km from KR Puram to the airport via Hebbal. Opening in phases, reported for completion by December 2027.
upcoming.why: A metro within reach turns a car-only address into a commuter address. Housing near this line was already carrying a premium before opening.

upcoming.status: A 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline, linking the city's outer north and east.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens trips between North Bengaluru and the eastern tech belt.

upcoming.status: Operating, nearly 950 acres, north of the site towards the airport.
upcoming.why: New factories and offices bring tenants and buyers who want to live within a short drive.

upcoming.status: Kempegowda International Airport keeps adding capacity and an Airport City business district around it.
upcoming.why: Airport expansion is named in market reports as the main engine of housing demand in North Bengaluru.

up: New offices at Manyata and the Aerospace Park filling up
The ring road and airport expansion being delivered
Limited supply of large branded townships on this road
down: Delays to the metro or ring road
Many large projects launching on the same corridor together
Peak-hour traffic on Hennur Main Road staying unsolved

weigh: The project is at pre-launch and its Karnataka RERA registration is awaited. Prices, plans and possession are final only once it is registered.
The indicative price works out higher per sq.ft. than the Hennur Road average. You are paying for the builder and the township.
Possession for a township of this size is several years away. Plan your finances for the wait.
The nearest metro station to the site is not confirmed yet.

area.name: Hennur Road
area.source: 99acres locality data via PropNewz, May 2026. Earlier values worked out from the published percentages.

timelineSource: Business Today, 6 Aug 2026; IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Oneindia, 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: The metro is in trial runs, not yet open. Buyers who come in now pick their tower and floor before the line changes how this address is reached.
